biotools.summary: graphPAF is an R package designed for estimating, inferring, and displaying population attributable fractions (PAF) and impact fractions. It offers diverse functionalities including Bayesian network calculations and displays attributable fractions over multiple risk factors using fan-plots and nomograms.
